page_title: MON 1-1 EIN | B. Monchengladbach v Eintracht Frankfurt 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+3' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Nathan Ngoumou.

90' What a chance that is! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
89' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

88' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Kevin Trapp inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
86' B. Monchengladbach are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
84' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' It will be a substitution. Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Mario Gotze walks off.
81' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) for a tough tackle.

79' That didn't go as planned. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Moritz Nicolas, who easily kept it out.

79' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
78' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps into a tackle and Christian Dingert signals a foul.
75' Substitution. Nathaniel Brown walks off the pitch and Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
75' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ellyes Skhiri.
74' A cross from the by-line finds Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
74' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a cross from the corner, but Kevin Trapp reads it well and gathers the ball.
74' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee signals a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
72' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box.
71' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Lukas Ullrich and he is replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robin Hack trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Good chance! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
69' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

67' Great save! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Moritz Nicolas.
66' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
64' The game is interrupted now, Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

63' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

60' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Christian Dingert with no other option than to blow for a foul.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch so that Michy Batshuayi can be given a rest.
56' The game is interrupted. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
56' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
54' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) makes a strong challenge and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
52' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
52' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
50' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
48' Christian Dingert shows the yellow card to Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) for a heavy challenge.
47' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
47' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Christian Dingert no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+1' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
42' Yellow card! It's like Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Christian Dingert agrees and books him.
42' Christian Dingert rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach).
41' There's a distinct lack of options for Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
39' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball.
37' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
36' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Moritz Nicolas.
35' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Christian Dingert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
31' 1 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:1.
31' Great touch by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he received a precise pass on the edge of the box. His powerful shot bounced off the goalkeeper’s gloves and hit the post.
29' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for a foul. Christian Dingert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
28' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Christian Dingert signals that the goal stands! The B. Monchengladbach players celebrate.
27' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The B. Monchengladbach players aren’t happy.
26' 1 - 0 Goal! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Florian Neuhaus.
25' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call.
24' The free kick is taken by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach), but ball is cleared.
23' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
22' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Hugo Ekitike.
20' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.

19' Kevin Trapp pulls off a decent save! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
17' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) has a goal ruled out for offside!
16' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
16' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.
16' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
13' The corner by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
13' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from B. Monchengladbach.
10' The resulting corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

9' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. B. Monchengladbach earn a corner.
7' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
6' Close! Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
6' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
3' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! B. Monchengladbach will take the kick-off.
Christian Dingert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
